corrections.proposed: ODF model 14 x 14 cab (current, per NHLR); earlier 1930s L-4 cab later modified (per firelookout.com)
corrections.why: NHLR describes the current cab as an ODF 14 x 14 model, and firelookout.com says the 1930s cab was an L-4 that was later modified. The single L-4 label fits only the earlier cab.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 1950 as the built year and says the 14 x 14 cab dates from the 1950s. A 1946 district report already lists a 14 x 14 standard lookout, and firelookout.com dates the first cab to the 1930s. The record keeps NHLR's 1950 for the current cab, and the story reports the 1930s and 1946 entries.

NHLR places the site on BLM land and says it is no longer in active service. firelookout.com says it is on private property with no public access. Both are cited, the access level is set to private, and the disagreement is stated in the story.
NHLR gives 4,809 ft (1,466 m) and firelookout.com gives 4909 ft. The record keeps the NHLR figure of 1465.8 m.

notes_for_editor: Record's design 'L-4' conflicts with NHLR's ODF 14 x 14 cab and with the 1946 district report. Build date conflicts (1930s first cab; 1946 district report; NHLR 1950). Land status conflicts: NHLR says BLM land, firelookout.com says private property with no public access; access level set to private pending confirmation. No source read is dated after 2003 except the Forest Lookouts history, which ends in the 1960s, so current condition is unverified. Forest Lookouts quotes a 1946 district report and 1963 to 1966 district reports. Spelling varies, Rancheria and Rancherie. Photos not added.
